description:
**About The Role**
 What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Coimbatore to build, evaluate, and improve AI\-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
   

  

 You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert\-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands\-on engineering work at the frontier of AI development — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Write, debug, and optimize code across a range of languages, frameworks, and problem domains
* Review and evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, efficiency, readability, and best practices
* Identify bugs, logic errors, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI outputs
* Provide structured, detailed feedback explaining why code works — or doesn't
* Design challenging coding prompts and edge\-case scenarios to stress\-test AI capabilities
* Compare and rank multiple AI\-generated solutions based on engineering quality
* Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* Proficient in one or more programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C\+\+, Go, TypeScript, or similar)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
* Able to read, write, and reason about code with clarity and precision
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and a systematic debugging approach
* Clear written communicator — you can explain technical decisions in plain language
* Self\-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience


**Nice to Have**
* Experience across multiple languages or tech stacks (full\-stack, backend, systems, data engineering)
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, LLMs, or prompt engineering
* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers
* Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps, or distributed systems
* Competitive programming, open\-source contributions, or side projects that demonstrate your craft
* Advanced degree in Computer Science or related discipline


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
* Freelance autonomy with intellectually stimulating, high\-impact work
* Directly influence how AI writes, understands, and reasons about code
* Sharpen your own engineering skills by evaluating diverse problems daily
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

description:
**Do you enjoy implementing innovative solutions?**
**Would you like to facilitate improvements in Workday??**
**Join our Digital Technology team**
 Our Digital Technology business provides intelligent, connected technologies to monitor and control our energy extraction assets. We provide customers with the peace of mind needed to reliably and efficiently improve their operations. Our team creates business value through continuous improvement in up\-time, resilience, performance, time to market ,security and compliance.
   

  

**Partner with the best**
 The Workday Developer, on the Digital Technologies Human Resources (HR) Applications Team, develops and supports our Global HR Workday platform using the various Workday integration technologies. The successful candidate must have a strong knowledge of Workday's integration technologies, Workday's implementation methodology and ability to partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless data flow and reliable automation across the HR technology landscape
   

  

 As a Workday Integration Developer, you will be responsible for:
   

  

  

* Designing, building, test, and deploy Workday integration solutions. Troubleshoot Workday integration issues
* Collaborating with Product Owners, and business stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective integration solutions within Workday.
* Analyzing and translating functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications
* Providing guidance to business, IT or service partners on integration strategies Contribute to the end users’ experience with Workday’s integration products, tools, and services in a way that results in high customer satisfaction
* Conducting unit and end\-to\-end testing of interfaces to ensure they function as designed based on functional and technical requirements
* Working with project teams through integration discovery and scoping phases of their implementation projects
* Coordinating for assigned deliverable schedules to ensure timelines are met
* Collaborating with cross‑functional teams to support Workday releases and associated regression testing.
* Following company defined change control processes to implement the changes and solutions


**Fuel your passion**
 To be successful in this role you will:
   

  

  

* Have a bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
* Have a minimum 5 years of overall experience and minimum 3 years as Workday Integrations Consultant / Developer
* Have a minimum 3 years of Workday integration skills with any of the following Workday setup tools: Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and PECIs
* Have a minimum 2 years of experience with integrating applications via web service APIs \- SOAP and REST
* Have a minimum 2 years of experience with JavaScript, XSLT, JSON, and xPath programming


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
   

  

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits


 The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Specialist \- Software Engineering
   

  

**About Us:**
 We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Join Us:**
 Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
   

  

 Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
An entry\-level position for candidates with strong fundamentals in blockchain concepts and programming, eager to build hands\-on experience in smart contract development and dApp integration on EVM\-compatible chains.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Assist in writing, testing, and deploying smart contracts on BNB Chain (Solidity)
* Support integration of frontend interfaces with smart contracts using Web3 libraries (ethers.js/web3\.js)
* Write unit tests for contracts using frameworks like Hardhat or Foundry
* Help debug and document contract behavior, gas usage and transaction flows
* Participate in code reviews and learn secure coding practices for smart contracts
* Assist with wallet integration (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and basic authentication flows (e.g., SIWE)
* Collaborate with backend and frontend teams to understand API/data requirements



  





**Required Skills** 



* Solid understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus, gas, transactions, wallets)
* Solid proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript (async/await, working with APIs/JSON, basic TS typing); familiarity with ethers.js or web3\.js is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Solidity (academic projects, bootcamps, or personal projects acceptable)
* Understanding of EVM basics and how smart contracts interact with the chain
* Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
* Strong communication skills and ability to work in a small, fast\-moving startup team
* Curiosity about financial markets, trading systems, or decentralized finance
* Comfortable with ambiguity and iterative development in a growing product



  





**Good to Have** 



* Personal projects or GitHub contributions involving smart contracts (even testnet deployments)
* Exposure to Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, or Remix
* Basic understanding of DeFi concepts (AMMs, liquidity pools, DEXs)
* Familiarity with React/Next.js for dApp frontends
* Coursework or certifications in blockchain development



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Strong problem\-solving ability and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced startup environment



  





**Selection Process will consist of three rounds** 



1. Primary evaluation will be executed through comprehensive, hands\-on programming assessments on the day of interview.
2. A formal code review followed by a rigorous technical discussion regarding the submitted codebase will be conducted.
3. A week\-long practical assessment involving a specific development assignment will be administered to evaluate candidate performance.



  





 Only final year students who can contribute full time will be considered for internship opportunities. Academic records and outstanding backlogs will not influence the selection process. Advancement in the evaluation process is contingent upon the successful demonstration of fundamental hands\-on programming skills.

title: OpenText Exstream Developer- Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**CCM Profile**
**Job description: OpenText Exstream Developer Senior Consultant \- (4 to 6 Years)**
 We are hiring an experienced OpenText Exstream Developer (including Dialogue, Empower Editor, Design Manager) to lead enterprise content management solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in OpenText Exstream (11\.x to 23\.x), system integrations, and modern document collaboration platforms. Good understanding of document lifecycle, template design, and outputs. Experience with batch and on\-demand processing. Knowledge of other scripting language is a plus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead architectural design and strategy for OpenText CCM solutions enterprise\-wide.
* Design integration architectures connecting Exstream Server with external systems via REST, SOAP, message queues.
* Develop secure, scalable applications, APIs, workflows, and automation.
* Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives and technical assessments.
* Provide mentorship to development teams and collaborate with stakeholders.
* Coordinate with infrastructure teams for deployment and operations.


**Required Technical Skills:**
* 4 to 6 years of experience in OpenText Exstream (11\.x to 23\.x) development and implementation projects.
* 2\+ years of experience in scripting.
* Extensive experience with integrations (REST, SOAP, middleware).
* Proven skills in Document Server integration.
* Strong programming skills in Java and JavaScript.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns, API gateways, message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
* Knowledge of microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Database expertise in Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL.
* Design and develop forms using the OpenText Ex stream product for high\-volume, on\-demand applications based on specifications.
* Should have strong knowledge in Data Mapping, Page Design, Output Queues, Flow Tables, and PDF\-Pass through, Dialogue application packaging.
* Experience in the configuration and customization of Ex stream objects at multiple levels, like messages, tables, and frames.
* Experience in print and assembly rules, bar codes, including adding variable data tags.
* Experience in data processing and post\-composition processing of documents using Exstream.
* Experienced with Input formats like JSON, XML, CSV, reference files and output formats like PDF, AFP, Archive, EMAIL, HTML, EMPOWER
* Experienced in working on search key, placeholder, tag sets, design layer, language layer, campaigns and messages etc
* Experience in data\-processing and post\-composition processing of documents using OpenText Exstream.
* Should have worked with formula variables, rules, functions, document, and page triggering rules.
* Coding and implementation support of printing, report preparation, and generation using OpenText Exstream.
* Experience working with XML files, various data files, and Report creation.
* Working knowledge of print streams like DLF, Empower, AFP, and PostScript.
* Solid design, coding, testing, and debugging skills.
* Experience in Unix Scripting.
* Basic Java knowledge.
* Experience with the Exstream version upgrade is beneficial.
* Experience in the Insurance domain is good to have.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Experience with OpenText Exstream versions.
* Knowledge of compliance standards (SOX, GDPR).
* OpenText certifications preferred.
* OpenText Exstream Version (16x/23x/24x).
* Unix Scripting.
* Java Good to have.


**Professional Traits:**
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and team guidance.
* Excellent communication with technical and executive audiences.
* Strategic thinker capable of aligning solutions with business needs.
* Skilled in project management and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Proven decision\-maker under pressure.
* Experience with vendor management and technical governance.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
